title: #43. Fath e Makkah 1
arabic:
اَعُوْذُ بِاللهِ مِنَّ الشِّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيْمِ۝بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَانِ الرَّحِيْمَ۝

اَلْحَمْدُ لله ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلى سَيِّدِنَا محمد وَعَلَى اَلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًا كَثِيْرا رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي َوَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي َوَاحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِنْ لِسَانِي َيَفْقَهُوا قَوْلِي

بِجَوَارَهْ اَنْصَابْ عَرَفَاتْ يَا مُعَاوِيَّه اِلَهَكْ اِلَهَكْ ، اَلْحَرَمْ اَلْحَرَمْ اِنَّ قَدْ دَخَلْنَا الْحَرَمْ، اِلَهَكَ اِلَهَكَ يَا نُوْفَلْ

لَا اِلَهَ الْيَوْمْ بَنِيْ بَكْرْ، أَصِيْبُوْا ثَأرَكُمْ فَلِعَمْرِيْ اِنَّكُمْ لَتَسْرِفُوْنَ فِي الّحَرَمْ أَفَلَا تُصِيْبُوْنَ فِيْهِ ثَأرَكُمْ

نُصِرْتَ يَا عَمْرُوْ بِنْ سَالِمْ نُصِرْتَ يَا عَمْرُوْ بِنْ سَالِمْ فَخَرَجَ نَوْفَلُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الدِّيلِيُّ فِي قَوْمِه ، وَهُوَ يَوْمَئِذٍ سَيِّدُهُمْ وَقَائِدُهُمْ، وَلَيْسَ كُلُّ بَنِي بَكْرٍ تَابَعَهُ

Ibn Ishaaq(اِبْنِ اِسْحَاقْ) says; كَأنِّيْ بِأَبِيْ سُفَيَّانْ مَا أَدْرِيْ أَرَغَبْتِ بِيْ عَنْ هَذَا الْفِرَاشْ أَمْ أرْغِبْتَ بِهِ عَنِّيْ ؟

بَلْ هُوَ فِرَاشِ رَسُول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنْتَ مُشْرِكٌ نَجِسْ فَلَمْ أُحِبَّ أَنْ تَجْلِسْ عَلَى فِرَاشِه يَا بُنَيَّ وَلله لَقَدْ أَصَابَكِ بَعْدِيْ شَر

مَا أَنَا بِفَاعِلْ أَنَا أَشْفَعُ لَكُمْ أَنَا أَشْفَعُ لَكُمْ عِنْدَ رَسُول الله فَوَالله لَوْ لَمْ اَجِدْ لَكُمْ إِلَّا الذَّرْ لَجَاهِدْتُكُمْ بِه

وَيْحَكَ يَا أَبَا سُفِيَّانْ وَاللهِ لَقَدْ عَزَمَ رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلى أَمْرٍ مَا نَسْتَطِيْعُ أَنْ نُكَلِّمُه’ فِيْهْ فَاِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّل اِلَى الله

يَا بنت محمد هَلْ لَكِي انْ تَأْمُرِيْ بُنَيَّكِي هَذَا فَيُجِيْرُ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فَيَكُوْنَ سَيِّد الْعَرَبِ إِلَى آخِرِ الدَّهَرْ؟

قَالَتْ وَالله مَا بَلَغَ بُنَيَّ ذَلِكْ أَنْ يُّجِيْرَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ وَمَا يَجِيْرَ اَحَدً عَلَى النَّبِى صلى الله عليه وسلم يَا أَبَا الْحَسَنْ إِنِّيْ أَرَى الْأَمُوْرْ قَدْ اَشْتَدَّتْ عَلَيَّ فَانْصَحْنِيْ

وَالله مَا أَعْلَمْ شَيْئًا يُغْنِيْ عَنْكَ وَلَكِنَّكِ سَيِّدُ بَنِيْ كِنَانَةْ فَقُمْ فَأَجِرْ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ ثُمَّ الْحَقْ بِأَرْضِكْ أَوْتَرَى ذَلِكَ مُغْنِيْ عَنِّيْ شَيْئًا ؟

وَاللهِ مَا أَظُنْ وَلَكِنْ لَّا أَجِدُ لَكَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكْ إِنِّيْ قَدْ أَجَرْتُ بَيْنَ النَّاسْ جِئْتُ محمدا فَكَلَّمْتَه’ فَلَمْ يَرُدْعَلَيْ شیئا

ثُمًّ جِئْتُ اِبْنْ اَبِيْ قُحَافَةْ، فَوَالله مَا وجَدْتَه’ عِنْدَه’ خَيْرَا ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عُمَر فَوَجَدْتَّه’ أَعْدَى الْعَدُّوْ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ عَلِيّا فَوَجَدْتُّه’ أَلِيًّنْ الّقَوْمْ

وَقَدْ أَشَارَ عَلَيَّ بِاَمْرٍ وَصَنَعْتُه’ فَوَالله مَا أَدْرِيْ هَلْ يُغْنِيْ عنِّيْ ذَالِكَ شَيْئًا أَمْ لَا ؟

قَالَ أَمَرَنِيْ أَنْ أُجِيْرَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ فَفَعَلْتِ فَهَلْ أَجاَزَ ذَلِكَ مُحَمَّدْ ؟

قَالُوْا وَيْحَكَ وَالله مَا زَادَكَ رَجُل أَنْ لَّعِبَ بِكْ وَيُجِيْرُ عَلَيْهِمْ اَدْنَاهُمْ اَلْمُرَادْ بِالْحَدِيْثَ مَنْ يُجِيْرُ وَاحَدًا اَوْ نَفَرًا يَسِيْرًا

اَجَرْنَا مَنْ اَجَرْتِ يَا اُمِّ هَانَى وَلَا تَهِنُوا وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ۝

وَأَنْتُمُ الْأَعْلَوْنَ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ مُؤْمِنِينَ۝

Allahعَزّوجَلّ says; اصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اِصْبِرُوا وَصَابِرُوا وَرَابِطُوا وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ۝

اَلا تَدْعُوْلَنَا ، اَلَا تَسْتَنْصِرلَنَا لَقَدْ كَانَ يُؤتی بِمَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَيُوضَعَ الْمِنْشَارَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ فَلَا يَرُدُّه’ ذَالِكَ عَنْ دِيْنِكْ

فيُمْشَطُ بِأَمْشَاطِ الْحَدِيدِ مَا بَيْنَ لَحْمِهِ وَعَظَمِهِ وَعَصَبِهْ فَلَا يَرُدُّه’ ذَالِكَ عَنْ دِيْنِكْ وَلِيُتِمَّنَّ الله وَهَذَا الْاَمْرَ

حَتَّى يَسِيرَ الرَّاكِبُ مِنْ صَنْعَاءَ إِلَى حَضْرَمَوْتَ لَا يَخَافُ إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَالذِّئْبَ عَلَى غَنَمِهِ، و الْعَاقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ

أَتَىٰ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ اِنْطَلِقُوا حَتَّى تَأْتُوا رَوْضَةَ خَاخٍ ، فَإِنَّ بِهَا ظَعِينَةً مَعَهَا كِتَابٌ فَخُذُوهُ مِنْهَا

تعادی بنا خیلنا لَتُخْرِجِنَّ الكِتَابَ أَوْ لَنُلْقِيَنَّ الثِّيَابَ ، فَلَمَّا رأت أنهُ الجد ما هذا؟

يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ، لَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيَّ،  إِنِّي كُنْتُ امْرَأً مُلْصقا فِيْ قُرَيْشٍ مُلْصقا فِيْ قُرَيْشٍ ، يَقُوْلُ كُنْتُ حَلِيْفًا وَلَمْ أَكُنْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِهَا

وَكَانَ مَنْ مَعَكَ مِنَ المُهَاجِرِينَ مَن لَّهُمْ قَرَابَاتٌ يَحْمُونَ أَهْلِيهِمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ فَأَحْبَبْتُ إِذْ فَاتَنِي ذَالِكَ مِنْ النَّسَبِ فِيهِمْ ، أَنْ أَتَخِذَ عِنْدَهُمْ يَدًا يَحْمُونَ بِهَا قَرَابَتِي

ارْتِدَادًا عَنْ دِينِي اَمَا إِنَّهُ قَدْ صَدَقَكُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دَعْنِي أَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ’ هَذَ الْمُنَافِقْ إِنَّهُ قد شَهِدَ بَدْرًا وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ ؟ لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ اطَّلَعَ عَلَى مَنْ شَهِدَ بَدْرًا فَقَالَ : اعْمَلُوا مَا شِئْتُمْ فَقَدْ غَفَرْتُ لَكُمْ

يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَتَّخِذُوا عَدُوِّي وَعَدُوَّكُمْ أَوْلِيَاءَ تُلْقُونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَقَدْ وَقَدْ كَفَرُوا بِمَا جَاءَكُمْ مِنَ الْحَقِّ

يُخْرِجُونَ الرَّسُولَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ أَنْ تُؤْمِنُوا بِاللَّهِ رَبِّكُمْ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَادًا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ خَرَجْتُمْ جِهَادًا فِي سَبِيلِي وَابْتِغَاءَ مَرْضَاتِي

تُسِرُّونَ إِلَيْهِمْ بِالْمَوَدَّةِ وَأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا أَخْفَيْتُمْ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُمْ ۚ وَمَنْ يَفْعَلْهُ مِنْكُمْ فَقَدْ ضَلَّ سَوَاءَ السَّبِيلِ۝

يُوْجَع وَيُحْبَسْ وَلَا يُقْتَلْ يَجْتَهِدْ فِيْ الْاِمَامْ وَلَه’ قَتْلُه’ وَمَالَ اِلی ذَالِكْ اِبْنِ الْقَيِّمْ صَلَّى الله عَلى سَيَّدِنَا محمد وَعَلى اَلِهِ وَ صَحْبِهِ وَسَلِّمْ تَسْلِيْمًاكَثِيْرَا
english:
The Life Of Muhammadﷺ Madinan Period Volume 2 By Imam Anwar Al_Awlaki, During the time of Jahilliyah(جَاهلِيَّة), a man from Bannu Hadhrami(بنوالحزرمي), who was an ally of the Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر).

You have sometimes, men who don't belong to a tribe, and they move and live with a certain tribe and then they become their allies.

And what is meant by allies, is that, the tribe protects this person and takes care of them.

And they treat such a person as a member of their tribe in terms of protection that is offered by the tribe, to its members.

So, this man from Bannu Hadhrami(بنوالحزرمي), he was traveling in Hijaz(حجاز), and when he was deep in the land of Khuza'a(خزاعه), Khuza'a(خزاعه) killed him, and stole his money.

So, Khuza'a(خزاعه) have committed this crime against this man.

And they killed him to take away his money.

So, the people of Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر), they took revenge by killing a member of Khuza'a(خزاعه) Khuza'a(خزاعه) then targeted three from the family of Bannu Aswad Ad-Doali(بنو الأسود أديلي)

and Bannu Aswad(بنوالأسود) belong to the tribe of Bannu Bakr(بنو بكر).

But they considered themselves to be above everyone else, and they consider themselves to be the noblest and they were considered to be the noblest among them.

In fact, they used to charge double the Diya(الدية), Diya(الدية) is the blood money.

So, everybody else from Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر) would take one Diya(الدية), while the children of Aswad(ألأسود) would take double the blood money.

Khuza'a(خزاعه) killed three of them.

And then Islam came and you would recall from Sulhal Hudaybiyyah(صلح الحديبية) that we said, one of the terms of the agreement is that whoever wants to enter into an alliance with Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) can do so.

And whoever wants to enter into an alliance with Muhammadﷺ can do so.

So, Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر) they entered into an alliance with Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and Khuza'a(خزاعه) entered into an alliance with Muhammadﷺ Khuza'a(خزاعه) were allies of Bannu Hashim(بنوهاشم), in the time of Jahiliyah(جَاهلِيَّة).

And now they became allies of the son and the leader of Bannu Hashim(بنوهاشم), Muhammadﷺ, even though many of them were Mushrik(مشرك) at that time.

Some of Khuza'a(خزاعه) were Muslim and some of them were disbelievers.

Nevertheless, they were all loyal to Muhammadﷺ even the disbelievers among them were loyal to Muhammadﷺ because of tribal tradition, not because of religion.

They were the allies of Bannu Hashim(بنو هاشم) before Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة) and now they consider themselves to be allies of Muhammadﷺ, even though, they are Kuffar(كفار).

Now, Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر) they want to seek revenge for the three of them, that were killed and we're not talking about any three, we're talking about some noblemen among them.

One of the leaders of Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر), his name is Muawiyyah Bin Nofal Ad- Doali(معاويه بن نوفل ألديلي), he was one of their leaders, he wasn't the only leader.

In tribal societies you have every small clan from the tribe has a Shaikh(شيخ) or Areef(عريف) or a leader, chief of the clan.

So, Muawiyyah Bin Nofal Ad- Doali(معاويه بن نوفل ألديلي), who is from the branch of Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر) that lost these three men, he attacked some people from Khuza'a(خزاعه)

because I'm saying people, not men because in one narration it says that they were elderly and children and women.

And these were as it says in the narration, They were next to the the Haram(حرم), the Haram(حرم) had stone marks to indicate, where the land of Haram(حرم) is.

So, these were very close to those stone marks but they were outside of Al-Haram(الحرم).

Muawiyyah Bin Nofal(معاويه بن نوفل) told his men; Let's attack!

And the rest of the tribe of Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر) refused.

And some of their chiefs refused, it was only Muawiyyah Bin Nofal(معاويه بن نوفل) and his followers who did this, not all Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر).

It is important to keep this in mind because of the implications of it.

When can war be waged against an enemy.

So, here it is clearly stated that not all of Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر) were involved in this betrayal.

Because it is a betrayal there is a peace treaty with Muhammad ﷺ between Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) and Muhammadﷺ, Sulha Al- Hudaybiyyah(صلح الحديبية)

and Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر) and Khuza'a(خزاعه) are part of that treaty, because they are both in alliance with the two parties of the agreement.

So, what Muawiyyah(معاويه) is doing is a breach of this agreement.

It's a breach of the truce of Al-Hudaybiyyah(ألحديبية).

Therefore many of his tribe refused to join in.

And as I also mentioned, the other chiefs of the tribe also did not participate in this.

So, they killed some of the people of Khuza'a(خزاعه).

Khuza'a(خزاعه) fled and entered into Al-Haram(ألحرم).

So now, they are within the sacred bounds.

And the Haram(حرم) is recognized by the people of Jahiliyyah(جَاهلِيَّة), they used to consider to be a grave sin, to kill anybody inside Al-Haram(ألحرم) or to kill anybody during the holy months.

There were four months of the year, when no killing should happen.

And there is the boundary surrounding Makkah, where no one should be killed and that is all throughout the year.

While within the four months all over Arabia no killing should happen.

So, now the people of Khuza'a(خزاعه) are already within Al-Haram(ألحرم).

So the people of Bannu Bakr(بنوبكر), who are killing the people of Khuza'a(خزاعه) with Muawiyah(معاويه), They told ’Muawiyah(معاويه); They are warning Muawiyah(معاويه)

and they are in fact amazed at what Muawiyah(معاويه) is doing, they said; So, they told him we have entered into Al-Haram(ألحرم) your God, your God, Muawiyah(معاويه).

They're reminding him.

What did Muawiyah(معاويه) say?

And look at the answer that he gave them.

He said: There is no God today, O Banni Bakr(بني بكر), Seek your revenge.

In the name of Allah, you are stealing from people inside Al-Haram(ألحرم).

Wouldn't you seek your revenge, there in.

Muawiya(معاويه) is justifying what he's doing and telling them; You already steal inside Al-Haram(ألحرم), how come now, you're complaining that we're inside Al-Haram(ألحرم).

Now, we have a point of killing and that is we are seeking our revenge.

And the people of Khuza'a(خزاعه) fled from Muawiyah(معاويه) and his men until, they entered into Makkah itself and they sought refuge in the house of the Badeel Bin Warqah Al-Khuza'e(بديل بن ورقع ألخزاعي).

This is a man from Khuza'a(خزاعه) who used to live inside Makkah.

So they went to him and sought refuge in him from this crime that was committed against them.

Amr Bin Salim Al-Khuza'e(عمرو بن سالم ألخزاعي) one of the men of Khuza'a(خزاعه), he immediately went to Madina, to convey the news of what's happened to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And he delivered the news to Muhammad صلوات الله وسلام عليه, in lines of poetry, reminding Muhammadﷺ with their alliance and reminding him with the alliance that they had with his great grandfather, Hashim(هاشم).

What was the response of Rasool Allah ﷺ.?

If such a situation was brought to the leaders of today, they would probably say let's take it to the United Nations, Or let's see what the Security Council will say,

Or let's consult with international community, or other ways of getting out of their responsibility.

When Amr Bin Salim(عمرو بن سالم) presented this to Rasool Allah ﷺ.

Rasool Allah ﷺ gave him a clear and direct and decisive answer.

He told him; One word, Rasool Allah ﷺ told him; You've been helped, Amr Bin Salim(عمرو بن سالم). That's it!

and they told her give us the letter that you have.

She said: I don't have any letter.

Ali Ibn Abi Talib(علي ابن ابي طالب) told her.

You either give us the letter or we would strip you from your clothes.

We will strip search you.

Because Rasool Allah ﷺ told us that you have a letter, that means you have a letter.

She was lying, but they told her this is something that was told to us by Rasool Allah ﷺ.

And if Rasool Allah ﷺ said: It, is the truth.

So, either give us that letter, otherwise, we'll take off your clothes, and search for that letter.

So, when she saw that the matter is serious, she told them: Aarizoo(أعرضو), turn away and then she pulled out a letter from her hair, it was hidden in her hair.

She pulled out the letter and the letter was from Hatib Ibn Abi Baltaa(حاطب ابن اَبي بلتعة), one of the Sahabah(صحابه).

He wrote a letter to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) informing them of the plans of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

So, this thing that Hatib(حاطب) did, acting as an agent for the Kuffar(كفار) among the Muslims is a very dangerous thing.

He's telling the people of Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) about secret plans of Rasool Allah ﷺ.

When Rasool Ullah saw the letter and he read it, he summoned Hatib Ibn Abi Baltaa(حاطب ابن اَبي بلتعة) and he told him; What is this?

And this Hadith(حديث) is in Bukhari(بخاريْ).

Hatib(حاطب) said; He said: O Rasool Ullah don't hurry in making a decision about me ٰ.

I was a man not belonging to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) I did not belong to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) He said: Your companions have families in Makkah, who would take care of their relative

because they belong to clans in Makkah.

They have people who would take care of their families and take care of their wealth.

But I do not have any relatives in Makkah, to take care of my family and my wealth.

So, I wanted to do Quraish(قُرَيْشْ) a favor, so that they would protect or they would not harm my family.

And in another narration it says; His mother was the one, who was living in Makkah and he was worried about her condition.

I'll read you the translation of his words, Hatib(حاطب) said; O Allah's apostle do not make a hasty decision about me, I was a person not belonging to Quraish(قُرَيْشْ)

but I was an ally to them, from outside and had no blood relation with them.

And all the immigrants who were, with you have got, their kinsmen in Makkah, who can protect their families and properties.

So, I liked to do them a favor, so that they might protect my relatives as I have no blood relation with them.

I did not do this to renegade from my religion nor did I do it to choose, heathenism after Islam.

So, Hatib(حاطب) is making it clear that I didn't do this as Nifaq(نفاق) or apostasy In fact, he used the exact word Irtidadan(إرتدادًا), which is Riddah(ردة),

Means I did not become an apostate.

Now, this shows us because there is a difference of opinion among the Ulema(علماء) whether such an act is an act of Kuffr(كفر), or an act of Fisq(فسق).

However, you can see here from what Hatib(حاطب) said is that he considers this act to be an act of Apostasy.

And that's why he's saying I didn't commit apostasy.

If he didn't consider this act to be an act of Kuffr(كفر), why would you say that?

Because he saying that I did not commit Kuffr(كفر), I did not disbelieve.

So, the fact that he is defending himself against apostasy, shows that he considered the act itself to be an act of Apostasy.

However, his intentions were not intentions of kuffr(كفر).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; He's telling you the truth.

Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said; O Messenger of Allah, allow me to cut off the head of this Munafiq(منافق), this hypocrite, again, Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) consider this act, to be an act of Nifaq(نفاق),

an act of kuffr(كفر), and therefore he wanted to kill Hatib(حاطب).

If he did not consider it to be an act of Riddah(ردة), why would he ask Rasool Allah ﷺ to allow him to kill Hatib(حاطب).

Rasool Allah ﷺ said; Rasool Allah ﷺ said: He has witnessed the Battle of Badr(بدر) and what could tell you, perhaps Allah looked at those, who witness Badr(بدر) and said;

O the people of Badr(بدر) do what you like, for I have forgiven you.

There are two things from the statement of Rasool Ullah, The first, it shows you the high status of the people of Badr(بدر).

The second is that, Rasool Allah ﷺ did not disapprove what Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said but he said: I mean, Rasool Ullah did not say that he does not deserve to be killed.

Rasool Ullah did not respond to what Umar Ibn Al-Khattab(عمر ابن الخطاب) said, in regarding to the Nifaq(نفاق).

But Rasool Allah ﷺ said; The reason why he should not be killed, is because he has witness Badr(بدر) which could also be an indication that Rasool Ullah approved the understanding of Umar(عُمَر),

in accusing a person, who commits such an act of being a Munafiq(منافق), but because Hatib(حاطب) witnessed the Battle of Badr(بدر), he should not be punished for it.

Again this shows us the high status of the people of Badr(بدر), and the great level that they have in the eyes of Rasool Allah ﷺ and even the angels because of Jibreel عليه السّلام, he came to Muhammadﷺ and said;

What do you consider the people of Badr(بدر) to be among you?

Rasool Allah ﷺ said: We consider them to be among the best.

Jibreel(جِبْرِيْل) said: And that is also with the angels who attended Badr(بدر).

So, not only, are the people who attended Badr(بدر) the best, but also the angels who attended Badr(بدر) are the best.

It is a battle that was witnessed by the creation of the heavens and the earth.

And then Allahعزوجل revealed; The Ayaat(آيات) of Surat Ul Mumtahinna(سورة الممتحنه) were revealed.

These Ayaat(آيات) are talking about this particular incident of Hatib Ibn Abi Balta(حاتب ابن ابي بلته) and again this is in Al-Bukhari(البخاريْ).

Allahعزوجل says: O you believe take not my enemies and your enemies as friends offering them your love, even though they have disbelieved in that truth

which has come to you and who so ever, of you Muslims does that then indeed he has gone far astray away from the straight path.

So, to all those Muslims, who allowed themselves to work as agents, with the kuffar(كفار) spying on the Muslims conveying information about the Muslims to the disbelievers,

they have committed an act of Apostasy, they are Munafiqeen(منافقين).

It is a very dangerous sin, it is a very dangerous thing to spy for the disbelievers against the Muslims.

And one of the ironies of our age is that in some Masajid(مساجد) intelligence agencies were given a booth to recruit from the Musalleen(مصلين)

to work as spies against the Muslims.

That's one of the most amazing things that happened in our age and time.

These are Masajid(مساجد) of Zaraar(ضرار), and we will talk about the Masjid(مسجد) of Zarrar(مسجد), when we talk about the Battle of Tabook(تبوك).

Regarding the Hukum(حكم) of Al-Jasoos(ألجاسوس), the spy who spies against the Muslims.

The Fuqahaa(فقهاء), the scholars of Islam have a consensus that the disbelieving spy is killed.

Then there is a difference of opinion regarding the zimmi(ضمي), the zimmi(ضمي) is the Christian or the Jew, who's paying Jizyah(جزيه).

According to the Ahnaaf(أحناف), their opinion That he should be physically harmed Ya'ani(يعني) painful harm and he should be imprisoned, but he should not be killed.

This is the opinion of Ahnaaf(أحناف).

The Shafiyah(شافيه) have a difference of opinion.

While Malik(مالك) and Al-Aozaee(أوذاعي) say; That this is a breach of their covenant with the Muslims and therefore they should be killed.

Regarding the Muslim, the Hanafiyah(حنفيه) and Shafiyah(شافيه) and Hanabila(حنابله) they say that he should be punished but not killed.

While Al-Malikia(مالكيه) say; The Maliki(مالكي) scholars say; That the Imam(اِمَام) has a right to do with such a person whatever he sees the Masliha(مصلحه),

whichever he sees is better, and he can kill him, if he wants to.

And this is also the opinion of Ibn Al-Qayyim(إبن القيم).

Rasool Allah ﷺ march forth in the month of Ramadan(رمضان).

And in the initial parts of the journey they were fasting but when they were getting closer to Makkah Rasool Allah ﷺ ordered the Muslims to break their fast

and he took a cup of water and he drank it, in front of them, to give them the example.

And the army was 10,000 strong.

This was the largest army assembled by Rasool Allah ﷺ so far.

All of the Muhajireen(مهاجرين) and all of the Ansaar(أنصار) were included And many of the tribes surrounding Madina participated such as Sulaim(سليم) and Aslam(أسلم) and Ghifaar(غفار) and Muzaina(مضينه)

all of these tribes they participated and that's why we have this large number of 10,000 strong.

And these are the Sahabah(صحابه) of Rasool Allah ﷺ, who witnessed the great battle of Fatiha Makkah(فتح مكه).

We'll continue In Sha Allah-Ho-Ta'ala(إن شاءالله تعالى) with the rest of Fatiha Makkah(فتح مكه) in our next session.
